answer: Compare against the naive design: one reviewer, no stake, no expiry. Then add three things. Stake every juror, slash the ones that diverge from the panel by more than a point, and expire any grade not renewed by fresh work within one epoch. An orchard of clones now has to keep three honest jurors on side and renew every epoch, and the beacon at the bridge is the slashed stake: a farm pays before it earns.
